TABLE.NAME: antivirus_verdict_scans
TABLE.COMMENT: VirusTotal scan lifecycle and normalised results for Moodle files

FIELD.NAME: fileid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle files.id when known

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle stored_file contenthash when known

FIELD.NAME: pathnamehash
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle stored_file pathnamehash when known

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle context of the file when known

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course id when applicable

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: File API component

FIELD.NAME: filearea
FIELD.COMMENT: File API file area

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: File API item id

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Content owner or submitter when Moodle provides one. Legacy manual rows may store the initiator here.

FIELD.NAME: initiatedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who started this scan event when distinct from userid

FIELD.NAME: submissionid
FIELD.COMMENT: assign_submission.id when authoritative

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Scan consumer: manual, assign, ...

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of file content

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: User-facing status

FIELD.NAME: phase
FIELD.COMMENT: Internal async phase

FIELD.NAME: vtanalysisid
FIELD.COMMENT: VirusTotal analysis identifier

FIELD.NAME: vtfileid
FIELD.COMMENT: VirusTotal file object identifier

FIELD.NAME: malicious
FIELD.COMMENT: Malicious engine count, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: suspicious
FIELD.COMMENT: Suspicious engine count, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: undetected
FIELD.COMMENT: Undetected engine count, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: harmless
FIELD.COMMENT: Harmless engine count, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: timeout
FIELD.COMMENT: Timeout engine count, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: totalengines
FIELD.COMMENT: Sum of known engine counts, null if unknown

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable internal error code

FIELD.NAME: enforcement
FIELD.COMMENT: Post-upload enforcement outcome for a malicious verdict

FIELD.NAME: timesubmitted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the file was submitted for analysis

FIELD.NAME: parentscanid
FIELD.COMMENT: Container scan id for archive member rows

FIELD.NAME: archiveoutcome
FIELD.COMMENT: Archive member-scan outcome on container rows

TABLE.NAME: antivirus_verdict_opcounts
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-wide totals of provider operations performed and avoided

FIELD.NAME: hashlookups
FIELD.COMMENT: Hash lookups sent to the provider

FIELD.NAME: uploads
FIELD.COMMENT: File uploads sent to the provider

FIELD.NAME: polls
FIELD.COMMENT: Analysis polls sent to the provider

FIELD.NAME: completedreuses
FIELD.COMMENT: Scans that reused a completed result

FIELD.NAME: inflightjoins
FIELD.COMMENT: Scans that joined an in-flight analysis

FIELD.NAME: lookups
FIELD.COMMENT: Reserved hash lookups

FIELD.NAME: uploads
FIELD.COMMENT: Reserved file uploads

FIELD.NAME: polls
FIELD.COMMENT: Reserved analysis polls
